title: Staff Product Manager - AI Detection & Discovery
description: Strength in Trust  OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.   The Challenge   You cannot govern what you cannot see. AI is entering the enterprise faster than any technology before it—often without a ticket: a team deploys a foundation model endpoint in an unmonitored cloud account, an engineer self-hosts an open-weight model, or a SaaS vendor quietly adds an AI feature to a widely used tool.   OneTrust is looking for a Staff Product Manager to own Detection—the discovery layer that finds AI models, LLM applications, agents, and AI-enabled features wherever they run, and turns that visibility into a governable inventory. Detection is the front door to AI governance: every downstream risk assessment, policy control, and compliance obligation depends on the completeness and accuracy of what you surface.   Your Mission   Strategy & Roadmap   Own product strategy for the Detection area across multiple related products, balancing delivery across the full product line. Set the Shadow AI detection strategy: discover unsanctioned models, applications, and agents; attribute owners; risk-rank assets; and route them into governance and remediation workflows. Define and sequence the coverage roadmap across detection surfaces, weighing build vs. partner decisions, connector investment, and the risk retired by each incremental surface. Establish the  detection taxonomy and definition of a “discovered AI asset,” bringing models, hosted endpoints, fine-tunes, RAG pipelines, agents, and embedded vendor features into one coherent inventory. Own the quality bar with measurable targets for coverage, precision, recall, time-to-discovery, and false-positive  rate ; make tradeoffs explicit. Identify adjacent opportunities, including continuous monitoring, AI bill of materials, third-party and supply-chain AI risk, and usage telemetry.   Cross-Functional Leadership   Lead geographically distributed engineering, design, data science, and detection research teams through ambiguous, discovery-heavy problems. Align with Product Marketing, Sales, and Partners on positioning and go-to-market in a category where buyers compare coverage claims. Partner with Security, IT, and Legal stakeholders—internally  and at design-partner customers—to test detection signals against real enterprise adoption. Work with Ecosystem and Partnerships on cloud marketplaces and integrations with adjacent tools (CSPM, SSPM, CASB, IdP, EDR, and SaaS management) where telemetry can be shared rather than rebuilt.   Technical & Domain Depth   Serve as the Detection subject matter expert while building knowledge of adjacent AI governance and privacy products. Bring deep understanding of AI deployment, including managed model services (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI), commercial LLM APIs, self-hosted open-weight models and inference servers, fine-tuning and training pipelines, vector databases, RAG architectures, and agent frameworks. Understand detection mechanics well enough to make hard approach decisions across API and control-plane enumeration, log and network telemetry, OAuth and identity analysis, code and dependency scanning, endpoint and browser signals, and vendor questionnaires or attestations where technical discovery cannot reach. Translate requirements from the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging state AI laws into concrete detection and inventory requirements.   Escalation & Communication   Serve as the primary escalation point for the product line, de-escalating issues and communicating clearly from individual engineers to executives. Represent  Detection strategy with customers, analysts, and prospects, and bring those insights back into the roadmap.   Mentorship   Informally mentor Product Managers and Associate Product Managers, sharing strategic and domain expertise . Raise the broader product organization’s bar for reasoning about AI systems, detection quality, and evidence-based prioritization.   You Are   A subject matter expert who handles significant complexity and exercises independent judgment. title: Senior Manager OR Director of GRC
description: ABOUT US Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. - We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. Location: New York City or US remote within the Eastern Time zone Team: Information Security Employment: Full-time THE ROLE Legora builds AI software for legal work. Our customers trust us with highly sensitive information and expect us to demonstrate how we protect it. As we grow across markets, our governance, risk and compliance program needs to keep pace with the business and the scrutiny that comes with it. We're looking for a Senior Manager or Director of GRC to lead that function. You will set the direction, develop the team and take responsibility for the quality and execution of our risk, compliance and assurance programs. You'll work closely with our CIO and leaders across Security, Engineering, Legal and the business to turn complex requirements into clear decisions and effective controls. This role calls for someone who can lead a global program and get into the detail. You should be comfortable challenging an assessment, examining evidence, resolving a difficult audit issue and explaining a risk decision to an executive or customer. You will work closely with colleagues in Stockholm, making reliable overlap with European working hours essential. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead the GRC function. Set priorities, develop the team and establish clear ownership across the program. Build an operating cadence that keeps work moving and makes gaps, dependencies and decisions visible. - Own the assurance roadmap. Lead certification and audit programs across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001. Maintain a common set of controls and evidence that can support new products, markets and customer requirements. - Make risk useful to the business. Lead enterprise risk assessments and reporting. Give leadership clear recommendations on impact, treatment options and tradeoffs, and work with accountable owners to complete agreed actions. - Translate requirements into practice. Partner with Legal and technical teams on AI governance, regulatory obligations and policy. Make sure requirements become controls that teams can operate and demonstrate. - Represent our program externally. Lead complex conversations with auditors and customer security teams. Give Customer Trust clear, accurate evidence and a consistent account of our security and compliance posture. - Connect the program across teams. Work with Security, Engineering and business owners on resilience and recovery readiness. Bring third-party risk findings into the broader GRC program in partnership with the lead responsible for those assessments. - Improve how the work gets done. Partner with GRC engineering on automated evidence collection, control monitoring and repeatable workflows. Use AI where it improves quality or speed, with appropriate review and traceable evidence. WHAT YOU BRING - Senior Manager: 8+ years in GRC, security risk, compliance or assurance, including experience leading programs and teams in fast-growing companies. You have owned major workstreams, set priorities and delivered results across functions. - Director: 12+ years in GRC, security risk, compliance or assurance, including experience leading a global or multinational GRC function. You have set strategy, developed teams and advised senior leadership on risk and assurance priorities. We will assess level based on the scope you have owned, your leadership and your results, alongside years of experience. Across both levels, you bring: - Experience leading GRC programs in global or multinational B2B businesses whose products or services handle highly sensitive information or support critical customer operations. - A record of leading and developing teams

title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system. What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d): German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing. Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably. Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design. Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later. Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs. Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate. How we work: AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production. Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence. Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital. Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints. Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog. Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage. What we’re looking for: Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team. Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count. Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes. Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code. Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required. Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team. Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act. What we offer Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow. Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals. Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities. Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement. Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories. Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany). Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones. Together: team meetups and company-wide events. Location We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. Manage Remediation & Follow-Up: Clearly communicate the impact of security issues and gaps to business management and agree on precise remediation actions and timelines. Manage follow-up programs to ensure timely completion of all Management Action Plans. Project Leadership: Lead a project to establish and perform a risk assessment process for BT technology. Lead Change Management: Lead change management efforts to overcome resistance and drive adoption of new security behaviors and risk processes across the organization, simplifying the path to compliance. Metric-Driven Continuous Improvement: Establish Outcome-Driven Metrics (ODMs): Define, implement, and track ODMs to measure the effectiveness of risk management, compliance, and control activities. Refine Program via Data-Driven Insights: Continuously refine initiatives based on organizational feedback and data-driven insights from metrics to ensure the BT Risk Management program maintains alignment with strategic objectives. Other Qualifications: Strong knowledge of internal controls, audit procedures, and compliance regulations. Experience designing federal SaaS cloud computing systems. Experience with Intelligence, DOD, and other federal programs. Successful record of implementing and improving operational processes as it pertains to risk management
